sources.excerpt: Official location page identifies Cooper's Hawk Reston at 12130 Sunset Hills Rd, Reston, VA 20190 and directly links current brunch, happy-hour, reservations, and carryout surfaces.
Current corporate menu hub links dine-in/carryout, chef recommendations, brunch, Wine O'Clock, dessert, kids, gluten-free, catering, and food-allergen guides.
Current June 2026 shared dine-in menu supplies the chain food catalog and nonalcoholic refreshments; its food names were corroborated against the exact Reston storefront before location assignment.

Official-linked ordering flow selected Cooper's Hawk Reston at 12130 Sunset Hills Rd and a complete fresh inspection covered featured, brunch, appetizers, surf and turf, mains, gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan, Life Balance, desserts, sides, kids, beverages, and nonalcoholic wine categories. Duplicate sizes, meal periods, and GF modifier presentations were consolidated.
Reston-linked January 2026 Brunch & Bubbles PDF lists the complete weekend brunch food menu, spirit-free drinks, and iced specialty coffees.
Reston-linked Wine O'Clock PDF resolves to the current February 2026 six-item appetizer menu; alcoholic beverages were excluded.

Restaurant-issued item-by-allergen guide marks dairy, egg, soy, tree nut, peanut, fish, shellfish, wheat, sesame, garlic, and MSG. It states the kitchen has shared preparation areas, utensils, and equipment; cross-contact is possible and no item is guaranteed allergen-free. Asterisked fryer items have additional cross-contact exposure excluding tree nuts and peanuts.
Current restaurant-issued gluten-free allergen guide corroborates the direct rows and separately discloses allergens for modified gluten-free presentations.
Fresh official-domain search located the current restaurant-issued food-allergen and gluten-free allergen PDFs.
Fresh exact-location and broader targeted searches corroborated the official Reston identity and surfaced no conflicting location-specific allergen document.
